ex.en: Toronto is a very multicultural city.
ex.zh: 多倫多是一座非常多元文化的城市。

ex.en: Our school has a multicultural student body.
ex.zh: 我們學校的學生來自多元文化背景。

ex.en: I hardly ever go to museums.
After ten minutes' walk we came to the museum.
ex.zh: 我們走了十分鐘就到了博物館。

ex.en: Please put out your cigarettes before entering the museum.
ex.zh: 進入博物館前請先把菸熄掉。

ex.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
ex.zh: 真正的友誼建立在彼此信任的基礎上。

ex.en: They want to talk to you about areas of mutual interest.
ex.zh: 他們想和你談談彼此都感興趣的領域。

ex.en: We met through a mutual friend.
ex.zh: 我們是透過共同的朋友認識的。
